messages:
alex: Morning — quick proposal: start a short, structured handoff sync twice per day to reduce missed escalations. thinking 08:00 UTC and 20:00 UTC, 15m tops. agenda proposal below. thoughts? :clock8:
maria: +1 for structure. 08:00 works for NA/EU overlap; 20:00 works for APAC. can we make one of the slots flexible on weekends?
tyler: Prefer 10m if we can keep it tight. Agenda needs: open incidents, active mitigations, who owns next steps, and any rollbacks in flight. Also: rotate an "escalation lead" per shift so paging is clear.
sasha: +1 to rotation. Can we add a short pre-read in the thread 30m before each sync with links to the incident pages? I can maintain the template.
ken: Also would like the oncall-bot to automatically post a summary after the sync (incidents + action items). Saves people from manual notes.
oncall-bot: [automated] Runbook check: latest oncall runbook updated at 2026-02-18 14:22 UTC — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handbook
linda: I can pilot the escalation lead rotation next week (Mon/Tue). happy to take notes and post the first summary. :+1:
alex: awesome — here's a compact agenda/template we can use (copy into the pre-read):
```
- 1) Quick state (1m): count open incidents, sev>2?
- 2) Active incident owners (5m): each owner 30–60s summary + next step
- 3) Escalations & coverage (2m): who is escalation lead and backup
- 4) Ops blockers / rollbacks (1m)
- 5) Action items + owner + ETA (1m)
```
Couple of process notes:
- pre-read posted 30m before, include incident links and short owner blurb
- escalation lead gets the pager/phone for the period and owns notifying PMs/infra if we go postmortem
- if >3 active incidents, we switch to an ad-hoc bridge and add extra time

action items:
- sasha -> create pre-read template and add to runbook by EOD Wed
- linda -> pilot escalation lead next Mon/Tue and post summaries
- ken -> hook oncall-bot to post meeting summary automatically (small script)

tyler: can we add a tiny metric to the pre-read: "pager backlog" (number of unresolved pages older than 30m)? helps prioritize.
maria: +1 on the backlog metric. also proposing we mark one slot per week as "deep triage" (30m) for incidents that need more time.
alex: agreed on backlog metric and weekly deep triage. i'll update the runbook with the agenda and tag owners. i'll schedule the recurring 08:00/20:00 meetings as tentative — we can iterate. thanks all. :rocket:
